description: Inference-only scaling of the W2 branch output: backbone = original(x) + alpha * branch(x). No training. QB validation (54 trainer formula, FP32) and RR test (common/evaluation_protocol.predict, common/metrics.rr_metrics), 53 C2MS and 43 C2 best weights, seeds 42-44. alpha = 1 reproduces the stored validation of every checkpoint and the 77 server RR evaluation of 53 C2MS seed 42.
